messages:
marta: quick question — when a model is unpinned and we automatically fallback to a compatible variant, are clients guaranteed the same response shape? e.g., should SDKs rely on `choices[]` + `meta` staying stable or do we expect structural diffs?

linus: short answer: we guarantee the top-level contract shape (choices, meta, usage) across compatible variants. content inside choices (n-best length, tokens) can differ. if we need to change structure, we will introduce a versioned header/endpoint.

samir: ok good to know. follow-up: we've been discussing removing `candidate_scores` in favor of `ranking` (array of objects). is that considered a breaking structural change?

linus: yes that is breaking. plan is: 1) add a new response version (via `Accept-Version: 2026-07-01` header) where `ranking` exists, 2) keep `candidate_scores` for a deprecation window, 3) set deprecation timeline and migration guide.

olivia: proposal: 90-day soft deprecation once the new version is GA, with SDK adapters shipping a shim that maps `ranking` -> `candidate_scores` automatically. also we should add a compatibility test in the SDK CI to fail if both shapes are not handled.

kevin: small ask: can we document what constitutes "compatible variant"? e.g., if fallback model uses different tokenizer, should clients expect different token-level fields?

linus: good call. compatibility = same response schema and semantics for existing fields. token-level fields (like `token_offsets`) are considered non-guaranteed unless marked stable in the model profile. we'll update model-catalog docs to mark per-field stability.

marta: logistics: who owns the comms? i can draft the deprecation notice + changelog entry if product signs off. olivia / samir — can you own SDK shims and CI gates?

olivia: i can pick up SDK shims, will open a PR next week. adding CI gating isn't hard — will add a compat matrix job.

samir: i'll own docs + migration guide with examples and a small eval showing output differences.

linus: i'll add the `Accept-Version` header support to the routing layer and make sure fallback paths preserve top-level keys. i'll also add a runtime flag to enable strict-schema checks in staging.

devbot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/schemas/pull/412 — adds `ranking` schema + version header contract. CI: compat-matrix failing 1 test (expected until SDK shims land).

marta: next steps: 1) linus implements header + flag (ETA 1 week) 2) olivia PR for shims (ETA 1 week) 3) samir docs + migration guide (ETA 2 weeks) 4) ops: schedule canary deploy with strict-schema flag enabled (post-shim). I'll collect approvals and draft the deprecation email for infra + enterprise Liaisons.

kevin: thumbs up. can we also add a short snippet for the public API docs showing both shapes and a recommended adapter snippet? makes migrations much easier for customers.

marta: noted — samir pls include snippet. thanks all :thumbsup:
